title: A shared bank
description:
Let several threads move money between accounts safely.

```
before: total 300
after 1000 random transfers: total 300
balances: [80, 150, 70]
```
hints: Lock once for the whole transfer: `let mut a = accounts.lock().unwrap(); if a[from] > 0 { a[from] -= 1; a[to] += 1; }` (lesson 6.02).
Pick accounts from the loop counter, for example `from = (i + t) % 3` and `to = (i * 7 + t) % 3`, skipping `from == to`.
requirements: Four threads each do 250 transfers of 1 between accounts chosen from a simple counter (no crates), never letting a balance go below 0.
The total must be the same at the end.
stretch: Give each account its own `Mutex` and avoid deadlock by always locking the lower index first.
